data.title: Essentials bar throws a Lua error in raids, and a /reload there leaves the addon deaf
data.text: When the Essentials bar needs more than its 10 lines (the lust and Battle Rez headers plus about eight providers: any 20-player Retail raid, or a TBC or MoP 25-man), every refresh stops with a Lua error before the bar shows. The same error stops the Lane view opening and /cdc roster printing. A /reload inside such a raid hits it during start-up, so for the rest of the session the addon hears nobody's cooldowns, group changes or boss ends.
tags: All clients (Era and Forever need nine or more druids)

data.title: Main panel fills with READY rows in a raid and stops showing running timers

data.title: Joining, rejoining or a /reload shows every Battle Rez and lust as READY
data.text: Someone who joins mid-run, is re-invited, or types /reload sees every other player's lust and Battle Rez as READY, and Request Rez can name a druid whose Rebirth was used minutes ago. It corrects itself only when that spell is cast again, or when a boss fight ends and each owner re-sends what is still cooling. On Era, TBC and MoP the combat log adds only the casts seen after you arrived. (The panel's late-joiner idea is the fix.)

data.title: Unticking a spell, or raising the minimum, stops your own casts reaching the group
data.text: Unticking a spell under Default Spells, or picking a higher Minimum cooldown to track, looks like tidying your own list, but it also stops your casts of it being sent. Groupmates see it READY while it's cooling, CooldownTimeline3 doesn't get it, and no ready-now goes out: a druid who unticks Rebirth still shows READY after using it, and the Rez button can pick them. Your own list still looks right, so you never notice.
tags: Retail and Forever (Era, TBC and MoP partly covered by the combat log)

data.title: Flask and food status only goes out when your buffs change
data.text: Your flask and food status is sent once after login and then only when a buff appears or drops. data.title: Flask and food timers restart at full length after every login or /reload
data.text: A flask or food buff is timed from when the addon first sees it, not from when you used it. After a /reload, a flask with ten minutes left shows its full hour again, and that time is sent to everyone, overwriting their panels and CooldownTimeline3. Re-drinking a flask before it runs out doesn't restart it, so it counts down to READY while the flask is still up.

data.title: A hand-made addon message can fake a cooldown on someone's rez or lust
data.text: Anyone who types a hand-made addon message, from inside your group or by whisper from your realm, can make a chosen player's Battle Rez, lust or any tracked spell show as cooling for as long as they like. That player's own casts don't fix it, so Request Rez skips them. It clears on their ready-now, when they leave the group, or on your /reload. It only changes what's shown; made-up names also add timers to CooldownTimeline3.
